name: Pigment yellow 111
description: thoughtful text 💡 Pigment Yellow 111 (CAS 15993-42-7 ), sold under the trade name Irgalite Yellow F 4G, is a monoazo organic pigment delivering bright, warm yellow shades across industrial coloration systems. It is formulated into coatings, plastics, and printing inks where consistent hue strength and substrate compatibility are the primary sourcing criteria for manufacturers and distributors. In industrial and decorative coatings, this pigment provides strong tinting strength and good opacity in solvent-borne and alkyd-based systems. Printing and packaging converters use it in offset and flexographic inks. Clean yellow reproduction and printability on paper and board substrates are required for these applications. Plastics compounders incorporate it into PVC and polyolefin formulations for consumer goods. Packaging films requiring stable yellow coloration benefit from its chemical properties. Leather and textile finishers apply it in surface coatings and pigment padding systems to achieve uniform yellow tones. Pigment Yellow 111 is supplied as a dry powder, typically in press cake or flushed paste form for ink and coating applications. Standard commercial grades are available at specific pigment concentrations. These grades are suited for both solvent-based and aqueous dispersion systems. Technical-grade material is the primary market form, with particle size and dispersibility specifications varying by end-use. Quality control ensures that the material meets the necessary industrial benchmarks for performance. This ensures reliability across various manufacturing sectors and specialized chemical applications.
